Safe water to affected communities of
chemical leak from Union Carbide
in Bhopal
*221. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH : Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Amnesty
Secretary General while addressing the
Prime Minister during 2006, expressed deep
concern that Government has failed to
ensure regular and sufficient piped drinking
water to all affected communities in Bhopal
in compliance with a 2004 Supreme Court
order, as several thousands of people in
several parts of Bhopal still drink even
today poisoned water, even after more than
two decades, after the deadly chemical leak
from the multinational Union Carbide Plant;
and
(b) if so, the details of action taken so
far, by the Central and the State
Governments?
70
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Wheat reserve
†*222. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there was a
wheat reserve of 101 lakh tonnes with FCI
during October, 2007 and in addition to
that 13 lakh tonnes wheat was imported;
(b) if not, what was the total reserve of
domestic as well as imported wheat with
Government; and
(c) the estimated requirement of the
wheat to fulfil the needs of the public
distribution system and all other welfare
schemes till the coming six months, i.e.
March, 2008?

71
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Prices of medicines
†*223. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps being taken by
Government for controlling the prices of
medicines and providing medicines at
cheap/fair rate to the poor;
(b) whether it is a fact that some
medicines have been added and some have
been removed by making changes at large
scale in the control-list by Government for
providing medicines at cheaper price;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of the efforts made by
the Cabinet Committee formed in this
regard and the achievements made in this
regard?
Electrification of Bangalore-Mumbai
rail line
*224. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the present status in respect of
electrification of Bangalore-Mumbai line;
(b) by when the work on this project is
likely to be completed; and
(c) the budget sanction for the purpose
for 2007-08 and the extent to which the
same has been utilized by now?
Spread of Japanese Encephalitis in
Eastern Uttar Pradesh
†*225. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards spread of Japanese
Encephalitis in the eastern regions of Uttar
Pradesh, particularly in Gorakhpur and
Basti divisions;
(b) if so, the number of persons who
died on account of this disease and the
handicapped patients suffering from this
disease;
(c) whether Government's attention had
also been drawn to such type of disease
during the previous years; and
(d) if so, the measures taken for
prevention of this disease and the measures
being taken for rehabilitation of
handicapped persons suffering from this
disease?
Sterilization performance
*226. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether concerned over a decline of
4.3 per cent in sterilization performance in
the country, his Ministry has further
enhanced the compensation package for loss
of wages to people who adopt family
planning methods and the compensation
has been doubled for men undergoing
vasectomy to boost male participation in
family planning;
(b) whether this is the second revision
within a year; and
(c) if so, to what extent would this
second revision help in implementing the
family planning schemes?

72
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Unmanned level crossings
*227. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the unmanned level
crossings, State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
has missed the annual target for manning
the unmanned crossings;
(c) if so, the details of performance
against the annual targets in the last three
years, year-wise and zone-wise;
(d) the reasons for under performance;
(e) the steps being taken to man the
unmanned crossings expeditiously; and
(f) the share of respective States in
manning such crossings?
GDP spending on health

PILANIA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be

Institutions and organizations dealing
with marine and inland fishers
1165. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of institutes and
organizations dealing with marine and inland
fishers;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
merge some of these redundant agencies
and organizations;
(c) the steps proposed to make all such
institutions target and objective oriented;
(d) the steps proposed to introduce
accountability for investment of
Government; and
(e) the policy changes to make
organizations contribute to overall growth
of the economy?
Decline in the production of milk
†1166. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of milk has fallen to the level of
15 to 21 percent in many States;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Shrimp culture in Andaman
1167. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to pump in
Rs. 20 crores in shrimp culture in 5 years
in Andaman;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a similar project is also
proposed to be launched in Orissa State to
improve shrimp production; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of Agriculture
Extension Scheme in Sikkim
1168. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of schemes formulated
and being implemented in the country for
the development of agriculture;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

280
(b) whether the Agriculture Extension
Scheme formulated by Government has
been implemented in Sikkim State; and
(c) if so, the details of funds allocation
for Sikkim during the last three years?
Sub-Committee to study and guide
FSI and IOTC
1169. DR. M.A.M RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has appointed
a monitoring Sub-Committee to carefully
study and guide all aspects pertaining to
the Fishery Survey of India and the Indian
Ocean Tuna Commission;
(b) if so, the terms of reference of this
Sub-Committee;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Fishery
Survey of India is reviewing all assurances
given to the Indian Ocean Tuna
Commission;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the Indian Fisheries
Organizations have been associated with
this Sub-Committee;
(f) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(g) the steps taken to protect the
interests of Indian fishermen?
Lesser price for fertilizers
and seeds
1170. SHRI SHARAD ANANTRAO
JOSHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state
whether there is any proposal to formulate
new schemes to provide fertilizers and
seeds at low price rates to farmers?
India’s position in cotton production
in the world
1171. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
become second in the world, by surpassing
USA, in the production of cotton in
2006-07;
(b) if so, the details of this magnificent
achievement;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in
2007-08 also India is on its way to maintain
its second position of cotton production in
the world;
(d) to what extent the Bt. Cotton seeds
helped in this regard;
(e) whether it is also a fact that the
cotton production has increased by 65 per
cent since 2003;
(f) if so, the details of cotton production
in the last five years, State-wise; and
(g) the cotton production of top five
countries of the world during the last five
years, year-wise and country-wise?
Decline in rice production
1172. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the production of rice in
the country has declined;
(b) if so, the details in this regard for the
last five years and reasons for the same;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the rice
consumption in the country is increasing;
if so, the details in this regard;
(d) whether in future the country may
face shortage of rice to such an extent that
it will have to import the rice; and

281
(e) what is being done by Government
to increase the productivity of rice in the
country?
